slices.title: Compaction trigger policy
slices.intent: New compaction.ts module resolves settings with floor policy from the parsed env flags and measures assembled driver context with the pi estimator, falling back to per-message estimates on zero or absent usage anchors. Disabled deployments see zero behavior change. User story 2.

symbols.name: resolveCompactionSettings
symbols.expectation: Resolves enabled, reserveTokens, keepRecentTokens with the floor policy; explicit overrides win.

symbols.name: measureDriverContextTokens
symbols.expectation: Returns the pi estimate on a nonzero usage anchor, else the per-message fallback sum.

slices.title: transformContext wiring and read path
slices.intent: makeCompactionRuntime ports the director runtime shape: disabled returns a pass-through; enabled measures, triggers, cuts at keepRecentTokens, summarizes, appends through the injected durable sink, and returns the post-compaction view without mutating inputs. runSession wires it into buildAgent only when enabled, fenced through writeRequiredSessionEntry; disabled bytes unchanged. User stories 1 and 2.

symbols.name: makeCompactionRuntime
symbols.expectation: Returns { transformContext, getTrace, dispose }; pass-through when disabled; full pipeline with injected summarizer and append sink when enabled.

symbols.name: runSession
symbols.expectation: Signature unchanged; passes transformContext to buildAgent only when compaction is enabled and configured; durable append fenced through writeRequiredSessionEntry.

slices.title: Compaction safety and observability
slices.intent: One durable trace line per compaction with before and after token counts and summary length. Failures record to getTrace().failures, return incoming messages unchanged, and append nothing. transformContext runs only at model boundaries, never mid tool call. Rejection paths of loadSessionEntryHistory stay byte identical. User stories 4 and 5.

symbols.expectation: Unchanged behavior; first compaction coverage lands in its test file; rejection shapes stay identical.
